environment.case_generation: random full-assignment subsets compiled to deterministic decomposable product/sum circuit DAGs

independent_oracle: The property test computes expected outputs directly from generated assignment sets, independent of the circuit evaluator traversal.
claim_ceiling: Five thousand random small deterministic/decomposable circuits agreed with an independent assignment-set oracle; three invalid structures/contracts were rejected. Not CPOG/VeriPB adapter, formal proof, solver binary differential, large-scale benchmark or SOTA result.
